description: Research open source egocentric datasets (first-person video of humans doing manipulation, e.g. Ego4D, EPIC-KITCHENS, and newer ones). For each: size, license, modalities (video, depth, hand pose, actions, language), and how useful it would be for training our world action model on the gripper. Write findings into the repo's docs so any agent can use them.

results.identified_issue: Research only, no code or downloads. Ranking criteria: eye-height view, stereo/depth, 3D wrist+finger+camera pose (needed to retarget to gripper aperture + SO-101 IK), language labels, tabletop tasks, commercial-OK license. Unverified: EgoLive and EgoVerse dataset licenses (not stated in their papers or project pages), Ego4D's commercial scope (secondary sources disagree, so read the agreement PDF), Nymeria's license (project page and HF card conflict), Ego-Exo4D hours (from memory). Egocentric-1M is blog-only and not on Build AI's HF page. MANO license risk applies to any dataset that ships MANO params, even when the video license is permissive. Sources were gathered through web summaries, so re-check before spending money or bandwidth.
results.summary: Wrote plans/egocentric_datasets.md: a survey of 14 open egocentric datasets, ranked by usefulness for our gripper world action model
results.detailed_description: The doc is plans/egocentric_datasets.md, and the README's repo map now links to it. Short version: no public dataset replaces our own gripper demos, but they help in two ways. Big video corpora can pretrain the video-prediction half of the model. Datasets with 3D hand and camera pose can be turned into gripper trajectories (the thumb–index gap becomes gripper opening, the wrist pose goes through IK to SO-101 joints). Top pick is EgoLive (1,680 h of head-mounted stereo RGB with depth, MANO hands and captions, so it looks like our rig), but its license isn't published, so we have to ask JD Cloud. Open-AoE (2,000 h, phone video, MANO hands, camera trajectories, atomic actions) has the clearest commercial-use terms. Build AI's Egocentric-100K (100k h, Apache-2.0) is video only and low-res, so it only helps with video pretraining. EgoDex (829 h of Vision Pro data) has the cleanest hand poses, but it's CC BY-NC-ND, so we can use it for research and evals and not for a shipped model. Ego4D and EPIC-KITCHENS are famous but the least useful to us: no 3D hand pose, and restrictive licenses. One trap: the MANO hand model itself has a non-commercial license, and it affects every dataset that ships MANO parameters, even ones that are otherwise commercial-OK. Suggested next step (not started): build the retargeter on EgoDex's 16 GB test split, then add a human-data mid-training stage only after our own gripper data gives a baseline score to compare against. Licenses I couldn't confirm are marked as unstated or unverified in the doc.
